links.passage: The model was evaluated on alfalfa and oats, resulting in 20% less water use.
supporting_passages: Using the GA and ML techniques, a model was developed by Hassan-Esfahani et al. (2015) from Landsat images, local weather data and field measurements and this model reported field conditions using a soil balance approach.
The output of this module is given to the forecasting module, which allocates water across the area covered by the centre pivot irrigation system.
links.inference_note: The cited Hassan-Esfahani et al. (2015) model is a data-driven water allocation/scheduling model built from Landsat imagery and weather data, and the later sentence in the same paragraph reports that its use resulted in 20% less water use.
reference_entries: Hassan-Esfahani, L., Torres-Rua, A., & McKee, M. (2015). Assessment of optimal irrigation water allocation for pressurized irrigation system using water balance approach, learning machines, and remotely sensed data. Agricultural Water Management, 153, 42–50.

notes: Review of water-stress detection methods; nearly all passages describe detection or scheduling capability only, not function outcomes, so few reportable links.
